text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Ah didn't wanna show ya this side 
of me again...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I trained so hard for today, and gave 
this race everything I had, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've got no excuse to face everyone who 
cheered for me...
choice_data_list:
Hold onto that feeling and you'll only get 
stronger.

The last thing anyone wants to see is you 
giving up.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"You're always, always helping me out. 
...But I feel so much better now...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san wouldn't ever lie to me, so I 
can get even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Countin' on ya! Next time, let's 
celebrate a victory together!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're right... My only real 
redeeming quality is that I never give up, 
after all!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"As they say, 'willows do not break 
beneath the snow.' Accept it flexibly, and 
carry it forward into next time..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I will definitely win. I'll 
show you I can win...!"
